title: Assessment of Practice where Insurers Offer Additional Coverage for Cancer Treatment through Riders
what_it_is: Assessment of Practice where Insurers Offer Additional Coverage for Cancer Treatment through Riders

sections.label: Cancer claim limits and riders
sections.summary: Questions ask about patients exceeding MediShield Life and MediSave cancer claim limits, available assistance, and Integrated Shield Plan enhanced riders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) in the past year, what is the proportion of cancer patients who have exceeded the annual claim limits of $1,200 from MediShield Life and $600 from MediSave for their cancer treatment; (b) what assistance is available for such patients; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider creating a separate claim category for the coverage of elective cancer drug services to avoid exceeding the claim limits for essential cancer drug services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) how will the implementation of enhanced riders offered by Integrated Shield Plan (IP) insurers to offset limits on oncological treatment coverage affect the Ministry's efforts to curb rising costs of cancer treatments in Singapore; (b) whether MediSave will be permitted to pay for premiums of these riders and, if so, whether this will contradict the Ministry's intent to impose limits on cancer treatment coverage; and (c) whether policyholders who opt for these enhanced riders will be required to have a minimum co-payment of their medical bills subject to a cap each year.

sections.label: Rise in cancer drug patients
sections.summary: Annual Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents receiving cancer drug treatment rose from 22,500 in 2017 to 31,500 in 2021, a 40% increase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The annual number of Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents who received cancer drug treatment and services increased from 22,500 in 2017, to 31,500 in 2021, which is a 40% increase.

sections.label: MediShield Life cancer claim limit
sections.summary: The claim limit for cancer drug services was recently increased from $1,200 to $3,600 per year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: A Member asked about the adequacy of the MediShield Life claim limit for cancer drug services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We have received similar feedback earlier and have recently increased the claim limit for cancer drug services from $1,200 to $3,600 per year.

sections.label: Government cancer drug subsidy spending
sections.summary: Annual Government spending on cancer drug subsidies rose from about $12 million for about 50 drugs to around $80 million for more than 100 drugs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Annual Government spending on cancer drug subsidies increased from about $12 million for about 50 drugs before the CDL announcement in August 2021, to around $80 million for more than 100 drugs from September 2022.

sections.label: IP cancer drug claim limits
sections.summary: From 1 April 2023, Integrated Shield Plans were required to set claim limits for cancer drug treatments instead of having none.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: From 1 April 2023, we took another step to require IPs to set claim limits for cancer drug treatments, instead of having no limits at all.

sections.label: CDL negotiating leverage on drug prices
sections.summary: MTI and CCCS lack extraterritorial power, but the CDL gave negotiating leverage to ask pharmaceutical companies to lower drug prices for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Internationally, this is not considered something illegal; neither can MTI or CCCS do anything about it, because they do not have the extraterritorial power.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But what we have done through the CDL, is that it gave us some negotiating leverage to talk to the pharmaceutical companies, to say, "Please lower the prices for the drugs that you supply to Singapore.

sections.label: Regulating IPs and riders
sections.summary: Together with MAS, the speaker is prepared to regulate IPs and riders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In which case, as I had mentioned just now, together with MAS, we will be prepared to regulate IPs and riders.

sections.label: Isolating MediShield Life and IP
sections.summary: The current design isolates MediShield Life and IP with the CDL, with a limit, so the sense is no.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Based on the current design, our sense is "no", because now, we have isolated MediShield Life and IP with the CDL, with a limit.
